message.content:
This editorial illustration features a red background with a prominent masthead reading "TEMPO" in white capital letters at the top. Below the masthead, smaller white text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". A barcode, QR code, and price information are located in the top right corner. The text "EDISI KHUSUS" appears below the masthead, followed by a paragraph in Indonesian.

Dominating the center is the large white text "100 HARI", with caricatured heads of two men placed inside the zeros of "100". One head is rounder with a broad smile, while the other is more slender with a slight smirk. Below this, the words "PRABOWO-GIBRAN" are written in a small white font across a dark horizontal bar.

The bottom third of the illustration is filled with a pile of grey shopping bags and several grey lunch trays containing circular and square compartments. The bags have simple thin handles, and their flat, overlapping shapes create a layered effect against the red background. All elements are rendered in a clean, graphic style with solid colors and minimal shading.
